title: mend-autopilot work profile
description: One file per work kind at profiles/<kind>/profile.json. check-profiles.mjs validates it with a built-in validator that supports exactly the keywords used here; a new keyword must be added there first.

paths.description: Globs that suggest this profile; the lead decides.

intents.description: Words in an item goal that suggest this profile.

riskFloor.description: Lowest risk tier an item with this profile can have.

ownerHints.description: Optional advisory owner suggestions keyed by item uiType; never automatic routing.

what.description: What counts as a good reference in the repo for this kind of work.

maxImageLongSidePx.description: Upper bound for image exemplars and crops sent to a model.

inputs.description: Files relative to the item evidence folder that integration checks read; frozen at proposal approval.

variantsWhenOpen.description: How many variants to produce when the brief leaves the shape open.

frozenBaseline.description: What stays frozen once the proposal is approved; null when there is no proposal.

humanApproval.description: A human approves high-risk items (including profile risk floors) and all visual work: UI, design, styles and art use always. Otherwise the strong supervisor approves, records who approved and when, and the human sees that decision on the evidence card before merge.

rubric.description: Check ids, resolved from profiles/<kind>/checks/<id>.mjs or a repo command in .mend/quality.json.

integrationDiff.description: Check id comparing the integrated result with the approved proposal.

fileCap.description: Most files a cheap owner may change in one item of this kind.

quantityApplies.description: Whether the item's quantity contract (G6) applies.

cardFields.description: Extra evidence-card fields this profile fills.
